lines.speaker: Kaneez Surka
lines.text: They are annoyed ke ye Prime wala pandrah pandrah hazaar lekar bhi ad dikhata hai.

lines.speaker: Abish Mathew
lines.text: Are you auditioning for the Lagaan ka role?

lines.speaker: Abish Mathew
lines.text: No, Kaneez's brain is connected to Vodafone signals. Buffering.

lines.speaker: Gursimran Khamba
lines.text: No, no, that's a good one. Kaneez, so your option, you're thinking it's C? Yeah, Rohan.

lines.speaker: Rohan Joshi
lines.text: I think the shocking fact is that they had never heard of Arundhati Roy. And then the security forces gave them an Arundhati Roy book, and then they immediately went back into the forest.

lines.speaker: Gursimran Khamba
lines.text: That was a good guess. That's the wrong answer, Rohan. That's the wrong answer. That was a very good guess, very good guess. Abish, why are you dancing?

lines.speaker: Rohan Joshi
lines.text: You know who is the real god of small things? The men.

uncertain: 'The men' (Daman / Daemen / Dharmesh; keyterm run: 'Kaneez Surka')
'pandrah pandrah hazaar' (pandrah sau on the option card)
notes: Punchline hinges on 'The God of Small Things' (Arundhati Roy) + the vasectomy answer. Sarvam+keyterms: 'ke ye Prime wala' → 'The Nation Wants to Guess', punchline → 'Kaneez Surka'.
